THE LITTLE ARCADE / GAME GUIDE

Pikachu Volleyball

A quick local volleyball game with movement, jumps, and timed attacks. Play against the computer or share a keyboard or phone with a friend. A match is played to 15 points.

Open the arcade & choose Pikachu Volleyball →

How to play

  1. Move underneath the ball to receive it and send it across the net.
  2. Jump to meet the ball higher and use the attack control to attempt a smash. Timing and position matter more than pressing repeatedly.
  3. Play the match to 15 points. Local two-player mode is a shared-screen match, not online matchmaking.

Keyboard & phone controls

Player 1 uses WASD and R; Player 2 uses the arrow keys and Enter. On a touch screen, use the movement stick and the Smash button. For local two-player play on a phone, rotate to landscape for both control sets.

Try these small improvements

Get into position first

Watch where the ball is falling and move under its path. Jumping too early can leave the player out of place when the ball arrives.

Change the timing

Try a regular return before attempting a high attack. A different jump or attack timing can change the path across the net.

Use a pause between rallies

Pause when rotating the phone or changing how you hold it. Resume continues the current match without spending another coin.

Free coins & starting a game

One coin starts a match to 15 points. Pausing and resuming that match are free. Starting or restarting a match spends one coin. New guest wallets receive 5 welcome coins; verified email accounts can claim 10 free coins once per Los Angeles day. You can read this guide without an account, cookies or JavaScript. Playing uses JavaScript and an available server wallet.

Coins have no cash value. Optional paid products and their renewal or refund details are explained in billing help. Rewarded ads are not enabled and are not required for the daily free coin claim.

If the cabinet does not load

Check that JavaScript is enabled and your connection is available, then return to the arcade. If a round is waiting for confirmation, retry that same round instead of repeatedly starting a new one. Do not pay again just because a game or order is slow.

For help, contact superpowergames.us@gmail.com with the game name and the on-screen error. Do not send passwords, sign-in codes or payment-card details.
